video_selection: Lexicographically first retained-test animal/daily/sport + original legacy holdout; fixed rule before scores

metric_comparison.cmn_initialization: Random CMN, zero residual over bilinear
metric_comparison.old_initialization: Published Conv3d weights; causal variants additionally prior50 + 2000 updates
metric_comparison.historical_metrics: Copied from fingerprinted old evaluation; same pairs and metric definitions
metric_comparison.old_seconds: Historical unwarmed per-sample timings, not compared with new warmed benchmark

test_reuse: All16 test and3 legacy clips were already inspected in earlier Conv3d trials; not blind
selection: Training best.pt selected only by dev latent MSE; this evaluation never selects weights
latent_metric_scope: All16 test +3 legacy; first36 real-anchor latents and35 valid warp pairs
pixel_metric_scope: Four fixed videos only; primary full120 vs decoded HR reference, source RGB secondary
causal_scope: Upsampler on fixed latents only; frozen original H3 decoder remains noncausal

padding_context.note: Unsupervised latent36 still enters the final noncausal VAE window z30..36. Cropping RGB120..123 does not remove its influence on real tail frames; frame102 has zero current-window crossfade weight, frames103..119 may depend on it. Region-specific temporal-difference metrics omit the cross-region frame101->102 pair.

warmed_upsampler_timing.scope: Upsampler only, FP32, B=1, input already on device; excludes VAE, I/O and transfer
warmed_upsampler_timing.warmup: Two full forwards plus one complete 37-step stream
warmed_upsampler_timing.stream_note: Per-step synchronization is included; full and streaming calls use different batching
